headline: ATL @ SFG matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ATL 4.24 at SFG 3.85, with a projected total of 8.10. Movement read: NRFI probability rose +12.0%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Reynaldo López has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Casey Schmitt, Mauricio Dubón, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Daniel Susac, Jorge Mateo because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
